title: Observational atmospheric angular momentum.
snippet: Reanalyses of Earth's angular momentum from ERA data. Data are divided by 1.0e+24. Each row consists of 12 monthly means. Data are given for each of 324 latitudes, starting near the S pole. Data are given for each year from 1960, starting from November 1960 to match model predictions.
